name: v1.109.1
body:
## Verify this release

```bash
cosign verify \
  --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065/cosign.pub \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.109.1
```

Same command for `litellm-database`, `litellm-non_root` and the `docker.io/litellm/*` images

## What's new in 1.109.1

2 PRs. 1 changed. 1 needs action

### Action required

- **Keys, teams and auth:** Move `tenant_id`, `client_id`, `client_secret`, `azure_username`, `azure_password` and `azure_scope` request tags into `metadata` (#51254) <sup>Also in [1.106.9](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.106.9), [1.108.6](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.108.6)</sup>

### Changes

- **Keys, teams and auth:** Changed model and pass-through routes to refuse body `client_id`, `client_secret`, `tenant_id` and Azure login fields (#51254) <sup>Also in [1.106.9](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.106.9), [1.108.6](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.108.6)</sup>
